name: 蘇文達
objective: 本課程內容包括熱量傳送操作及其應用。
schedule:
第一週 課程內容介紹
第二週 heat transfer by conduction
第三週 heat transfer by conduction and its application
第四週 principles of heat flow in fluid
第五週 principles of heat flow in fluid
第六週 principles of heat flow in fluid
第七週 第 1 次考試
第八週 heat transfer to fluid without phase change
第九週 heat transfer to fluid without phase change
第十週 heat transfer to fluid with phase change
第十一週 heat exchange equipment
第十二週 heat exchange equipment
第十三週 evaporation
第十四週 evaporation
第十五週 第 2 次考試
第十六週 熱交換器設計與互評
第十七週 熱換器設計
第十八週 熱換器設計
scorePolicy:
作業與平時小考 15%
出缺席 10%, 曠課每次扣 1 分 (公假, 喪假與重大 & 住院疾病除外)
考試 50%
期末互評 10%
設計方案 15%

● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)

Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.

Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
